paragraphs: I'm a versatile software engineer with 10+ years of experience designing, building, and optimizing cloud-native applications in the Cards and Payments domain.

I specialize in backend systems using Java (Spring Boot & Quarkus) and Apache Kafka, and I follow modern architecture patterns like Hexagonal Architecture and event-driven design to ensure scalable and maintainable solutions.

What sets me apart is my hybrid engineering mindset — I bring the depth of a developer and the precision of a test engineer, with strong experience in CI/CD, automation frameworks, performance tuning, and cloud-native deployments.
